ticket.subject: Template changes not saving
ticket.body_text:
Dear Support Team,

I look after our account at Brambleway Studio. Every time I edit a project template and press Save, I get 'Something went wrong' and the change is lost.

Our onboarding process is built on these templates, and there is no other way to edit them. I tried a different browser and a private window with the same result.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please help us fix this quickly.

Yours sincerely,
Mateo Pemberton

label_notes: clean bug (bug-save-error): a core workflow is broken for one customer with no workaround, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
